text:
mina: launched a minimal Next + LangChain starter that demonstrates LlamaIndex for product docs. Seeing confusing behavior on first-run installs: postinstall validator we added to detect SDK runtime parity is failing CI for some users (monorepo hoisting + pnpm). repo: https://git.company/oss/next-lc-starter
jared: what's the validator doing exactly?
mina: simple check in scripts/postinstall.js that reads package-lock/yarn.lock and ensures @redwood/inference versions match between edge and node examples. If mismatch, it exits non-zero to force pinning.
build-bot: recent CI runs show failures on pnpm workspaces where lockfile layout differs. example error:
```
> node scripts/postinstall.js
Error: lockfile not found: expected package-lock.json or yarn.lock
process exited with code 1
```
toni: ouch, postinstall scripts that error out on unknown setups are a big DX footgun. we want to warn, not break installs in heterogeneous repos.
mina: agreed. the original intent was to prevent subtle serializer mismatches that lead to index rebuilds across runtimes. but breaking installs is too harsh.
infra: mitigation: change postinstall to be best-effort: detect lockfile, if not found emit a clear console.warn with remediation links and continue. also add a CI quickcheck job that runs in our starter CI to enforce parity for us, but not for end users.
jared: also add an opt-in env var SKIP_POSTINSTALL_CHECK for internal contributors who do monorepos.
mina: good call. I'll change script to warn, and add a `scripts/ci-validate-runtime.sh` that runs in GH actions to fail in our CI matrix.
toni: for developer onboarding, include a short troubleshooting section in README explaining: serializer mismatch symptoms ("unrecognized snapshot"), auth retry patterns that can mask the issue, and the recommended fixes (pin SDK versions or explicit serializer).
mina: also adding a small eval harness e2e: run headless SSR -> persist index -> invoke edge loader -> assert no rebuild by checking trace spans. will wire into the starter's `ci-validate-runtime` job.
infra: one more: tweak the SDK to log serializer and SDK semver when loading snapshots so users see helpful diagnostics in logs. file an SDK issue and link it in the README.
mina: opening PR with: (1) postinstall -> warn-only, (2) CI validator, (3) README troubleshooting, (4) e2e harness. tagging @toni for review.
jared: thanks, marking as low-sev DX but high onboarding signal. :thumbsup:
